title: Strike at the Candy Factory
description: Strike at the Candy Factory — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 1A

Quest Reward: 10000 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Wally Wanka

Repeatable: Unknown

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 4A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Is it storytime again already? Ok, let me get a sip of my Vergrim's Fizzerator energy drink, brought to you by Vergrim and the proud Whiskers of Vergrim's Vexation. Try Vergrim's Fizzerator for a true taste of freakified dynamizmic forcitude! Ok, so I've been reduced to doing second rate advertisements to keep from being completely broke. It's not my proudest moment, but I have to pay those respec bills somehow.

Anyway, where did I leave off? Ahh, yes, I was closing down the candy factory to the public. At the time it made sense, closing off access to the candy factory would keep the spies from getting in. If I had only known that I was actually locking the spies in! You see, it turned out that the Abba Labbas were actually genetically engineered by the Fade overlord, Abaddon! Once I locked the factory to outsiders the Abba Labbas started acting very strange. Every time they would see me they would all look at me and sing that creepy song of theirs. That's when I decided that the Abba Labbas had to go. Oh, if only it was as simple as that....

I can fill you in on the rest when you return, but now I need you to get out there and help me to regain my candy factory! Storeroom 4A in The Embercore Path is where I need you to strike next. Take some of those Candy Fabricators out of action so we can slow down Abaddon's candy production. When you have made sure that those machines won't be making more candy any time soon, return to me, Wally Wanka, here in The Embercore Portal.

Turn-in:

Please tell me that Abaddon is going to have to call the Mehtag man to fix his machines. Excellent! Here is something for you.

Objectives:

  • Candy Fabricators

Level range: 44–100
